## Why

Owners who use the pointer want to click tabs, rows and project keys. docs/dashboard.md:12 says mouse clicks do the same as keys. The owner question ui.mouse is not in adj (`adj check ui.mouse` says "not found"), so it has not been asked. Mouse capture also blocks terminal text selection, which matters for copying the slicer land command (docs/dashboard.md:102-103).
